providers.label: OpenRouter
providers.notes: Routes to hundreds of models on one key; `openrouter/auto` is not tool-safe and is deliberately not the default. Tool schemas go out with OpenAI's `strict` flag; if a routed non-OpenAI model rejects a tool call, pick an OpenAI model or an `order` of providers known to support strict tools.

providers.label: OpenRouter (STT)
providers.notes: Batch transcription over HTTP: no interim results; each turn is transcribed after end-of-speech, so expect roughly half a second to two seconds more per turn than a streaming STT. For low latency prefer LiveKit Inference STT or Deepgram.

providers.label: Krisp
providers.notes: Deferred (asks #56): livekit-plugins-krisp has no 1.8.2 release on PyPI (it is versioned independently, latest 0.4.2), so the lockstep ==1.8.2 pin of CONTRACTS-V2 §7 cannot install, and 0.4.2 is unverified against the 1.8.2 plugin ABI. Ships a native livekit-plugins-krisp-internal wheel. Re-enable after an import check of a compatible release in the full image.

providers.label: AvatarTalk
providers.notes: Shortest ctor of the 16 in-tree avatars (no conn_options). Also has a genuine on-prem/on-device mode.

providers.label: D-ID
providers.notes: agent_id has no NotGivenOr wrapper, unlike every other avatar's id field: a true required kwarg.

providers.label: Keyframe
providers.notes: Exactly one of persona_id/persona_slug is required.

providers.label: LemonSlice
providers.notes: Exactly one of agent_id/agent_image_url/agent_image is required; ctor also accepts **kwargs passthrough.

providers.label: Runway
providers.notes: Exactly one of avatar_id/preset_id is required.

providers.label: Spatius
providers.notes: Requires two ids (app_id + avatar_id), unlike every other avatar plugin.

fields.help: Up to 5 gallery avatar ids ({"avatar_ids": [...]}); the first is active, the rest swappable in-session via swap_avatar().

fields.name: avatar_config

providers.label: Synthesia
providers.notes: avatar_config is positional, not keyword-only — the only avatar ctor shaped this way besides D-ID's required agent_id.

providers.label: AWS Nova Sonic
providers.notes: __init__ takes no api_key/api_secret/credentials kwarg at all (verified: AST snapshot has no auth param on this constructor) — resolved purely through the standard boto3/AWS credential chain, unlike the catalog draft's claim of a flat api_key/api_secret pair. modalities is audio|mixed only: no half-cascade path.

fields.help: Most behavior (voice, tools, prompts) is configured on Phonic's own dashboard against this agent id.
fields.label: Phonic agent id
fields.name: phonic_agent

providers.label: Phonic
providers.notes: A fully hosted conversational-agent platform (40+ ctor kwargs) more than a plain realtime model; most behavior lives in Phonic's own dashboard against phonic_agent, not in these fields.

providers.label: OpenAI GPT-Live
providers.notes: Delegates response generation to the Responses API rather than the classic Realtime event stream.

providers.label: OpenAI (Responses API)
providers.notes: Distinct class from openai.LLM (chat completions); uses the Responses API over a websocket by default.

providers.label: Fal Wizper
providers.notes: Class is named WizperSTT, not STT.

providers.label: Gradium
providers.notes: Self-deployed model endpoint (like Baseten/Simplismart), not a shared public model catalog.

providers.label: Slng
providers.notes: Router/gateway product: routes to a configured upstream STT model, not a fixed vendor model.

providers.label: Simplismart
providers.notes: Self-deployed inference; api_key authenticates the tenant's Simplismart deployment.

providers.label: Palabra
providers.notes: Real-time translation ASR.

fields.help: boto-style Credentials object; omit to use the standard AWS credential chain (this class, unlike aws.LLM/aws.TTS, has no flat api_key/api_secret kwarg).

providers.notes: Not in the livekit/agents 1.8.2 monorepo tree (absent from this pass's clone, confirming the catalog's finding); last released 2025-10-15 against a much older core. Compatibility with livekit-agents>=1.8.2 is unverified, not disproven.

secret_fields.help: PlayAI requires both an API key and a user id.
secret_fields.label: User id

providers.label: NVIDIA PersonaPlex
providers.notes: Explicit PLAN-V2 correction. Constructor takes no api_key kwarg (confirmed: base_url, http_session, seed, silence_threshold_ms, text_prompt, voice only) and no conn_options/tool_choice either — the least mature realtime integration of the set.

providers.label: Noise Cancellation (legacy)
providers.notes: Out-of-tree (not in the 1.8.2 monorepo clone); only requires_dist (livekit>=0.21.3) is known from PyPI metadata. Likely the older client/room-level Krisp BVC wrapper, distinct from the in-tree livekit-plugins-krisp. Left deferred rather than guessing a class path.

providers.label: ai-coustics
providers.notes: Out-of-tree (not in the 1.8.2 monorepo clone); only requires_dist (livekit-agents>=1.4.2) is known from PyPI metadata. Left deferred rather than guessing a class path.

providers.label: RTZR (Vito)
providers.notes: __init__ has no api_key/credential kwarg at all (confirmed by AST snapshot) — auth is resolved internally by an rtzrapi.py helper the factory cannot reach with per-tenant credentials, so a shared worker process could not keep two tenants' RTZR keys separate. Deferred until that's resolved upstream.

providers.label: Spitch
providers.notes: Same gap as rtzr-stt: __init__ takes no credential kwarg (confirmed by AST snapshot) — the AsyncSpitch() client resolves its own env var internally, which the factory cannot pass per-tenant.

providers.label: Spitch
providers.notes: Same gap as spitch-stt.

providers.label: MiniMax
providers.notes: livekit-plugins-minimax 1.3.0 pins livekit-agents==1.2.9 exactly, five releases behind this platform's 1.8.2 baseline; uv pip compile confirms the two cannot resolve together in one environment. Not installable until the vendor republishes against current core.
